parameters.name: Categories
parameters.description: The list of templatetype for the execute. Valid values: Other, TimerTrigger, EventTrigger, AlarmTrigger. You can specify only one of this parameter and the Category parameter. We recommend that you use Categories.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The template type of the execution. Valid values: Other, TimerTrigger, EventTrigger, AlarmTrigger.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: The depth of the execution. Valid values: RootDepth, FirstChildDepth. RootDepth returns only the root executions. FirstChildDepth returns only the first-level child executions. You can specify only one of this parameter and the IncludeChildExecution parameter. We recommend that you use Depth.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the execution.

parameters.name: EndDateAfter
parameters.description: Specifies that the end time of the executions to query is later than or equal to the specified time.

parameters.name: EndDateBefore
parameters.description: Specifies that the end time of the executions to query is earlier than or equal to the specified time.

parameters.name: ExecutedBy
parameters.description: The executor.

parameters.name: ExecutionId
parameters.description: The execution ID.

parameters.name: IncludeChildExecution
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include child executions. Default value: False.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The execution mode. Valid values:
- **Automatic**
- **Debug**

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token.

parameters.name: ParentExecutionId
parameters.description: The parent execution ID.

parameters.name: RamRole
parameters.description: The RAM role.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ECS resource ID.

parameters.name: ResourceTemplateName
parameters.description: The template name of the resource.

parameters.name: SortField
parameters.description:
The field used to sort the query results. Valid values:

- **StartDate** (default): the creation time.
- **EndDate**: the end time.
- **Status**: the status.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:
- **Ascending**: ascending order.
- **Descending** (default): descending order.

parameters.name: StartDateAfter
parameters.description: Specifies that the start time of the executions to query is later than or equal to the specified time.

parameters.name: StartDateBefore
parameters.description: Specifies that the start time of the executions to query is earlier than or equal to the specified time.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The execution status. Valid values: Running, Started, Success, Failed, Waiting, Cancelled, Pending, Skipped.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags of the execution.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The template name. This is a fuzzy match. All templates whose names contain the specified value are returned.
